summary: A framework-free Go HTTP client (shared by TUI and CLI) that abstracts all Barkpark Phoenix API interactions — document CRUD, schema/structure loading, real-time change detection via SSE with poll fallback, and task claim/close operations.

intentions.title: Decouple API access from any UI framework so TUI and CLI share one client
intentions.evidence: client.go package comment: 'ZERO Bubble Tea dependency'; OnChange callback replaces tea.Program coupling; Config.Perspective differentiates TUI (drafts) from CLI (published)

intentions.title: Normalize the v1 flat envelope onto legacy typed fields without breaking existing consumers
intentions.evidence: Doc.UnmarshalJSON + normalizeEnvelope in client.go: maps _id/_updatedAt/_draft onto ID/UpdatedAt/Status, fills Values from flattened content fields, guards against double-applying

intentions.title: Surface real-time dataset changes to interactive consumers
intentions.evidence: StartSSE + listenSSE in client.go: SSE stream fires OnChange on mutation events; pollOnce fallback hashes _id:_rev pairs via exportDocSetHash so spurious refreshes are suppressed

intentions.title: Protect structured data from accidental scalar overwrite in the editor
intentions.evidence: schema.go FieldRaw enum + parseFieldType: v2 plugin types (object, composite, arrayOf, codelist, localizedText) map to read-only FieldRaw instead of editable FieldString

intentions.title: Expose task claim/close with fencing epoch for safe concurrent task dispatch
intentions.evidence: TaskClaim and TaskClose in client.go: taskPost targets /v1/tasks/:id/claim and /close, carries observed_epoch for server-side fencing, returns epoch to caller for CAS

intentions.title: Support multi-tenant workspace/project scoping across all API calls
intentions.evidence: scopedURL in client.go builds /w/:workspace/p/:project prefix; Config carries Workspace/Project/Dataset; CreateWorkspace/CreateProject/ListWorkspaces/ListProjects manage the tenant hierarchy
